notes: ACCESS: direct HTTP via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome), no proxy/IPv6 pinning needed this session (prior Furniture-pass notes said IPv4 egress was dead and required a Cloudflare IPv6 pin; that was not needed here - plain requests to www.wayfair.com succeeded, egress conditions changed). robots.txt checked first: no Claude-specific disallow, generic 'User-agent: *' rules only (Disallow covers /ajax/, /filter(s)/, /shop/, /flashdeals-adjacent internals, etc. - none block research access). DISCOVERY: fetched homepage (www.wayfair.com/) and extracted the SSR-embedded 'Departments' mega-nav JSON plus the visually-hidden 'Department Navigation' link list. Found 'Best Sellers' as a direct, first-class nav item (href https://www.wayfair.com/curated/best-sellers~ev565448.html), alongside sibling nav items 'New Arrivals', 'Shop the Look', and 'Sale'. Opened it: page renders via Wayfair's DailySalesEventPage/eventbrowse template (eventName='best-sellers', eventId=565448), a genuine paginated product listing (pagination links to curpage=2,3,4 present), not editorial/marketing content. Because this page type is heavily client-hydrated, the SSR HTML shows a '-1' placeholder count in the visible DOM, but the SSR JSON payload's own pageTrackingMetadata carries the true totalSKUCount used for tracking/analytics (this is the same field family the prior Home-Decor/Furniture pass cross-validated as an exact, trustworthy product count on regular Wayfair category pages). CONSIDERED AND EXCLUDED: 'Smart Home Essentials' (URL slug 'trending-now:-smart-home~ev611479.html') - the URL slug contains 'trending' but the page's own visible name/label is 'Smart Home Essentials', a themed collection, not a Bestsellers/Trending-labeled listing - excluded per the brief's rule that a candidate must genuinely represent the bestseller/popularity concept, not merely have a suggestive URL. Several 'top-rated-*' curated pages under /daily-sales/ds/ (e.g. top-rated-furniture, top-rated-lighting) were also seen in nav/sitemap-adjacent links but 'top-rated' (customer ratings) is not one of the brief's accepted Bestsellers target terms (Best Sellers/Bestselling/Top Sellers/Popular/Trending/Customer Favorites) and was not pursued. One candidate, https://www.wayfair.com/daily-sales/ds/best-selling-vanity-lighting-se19069.html ('best-selling' in its slug, found under the /daily-sales hub linked from the 'Sale' nav item), was identified but NOT opened/verified: the host began returning HTTP 429 (rate-limited) partway through this session while fetching two unrelated Clearance sub-pages, and per protocol the first block stops further requests to that host, so this candidate could not be confirmed as a real PLP vs. a narrow single-item promo tile and is omitted from rows rather than guessed. Only one confirmed, undifferentiated Bestsellers listing exists on the site, so sub_category equals category. No site search was needed since a direct, unambiguous main-nav 'Best Sellers' link was found.

rows.evidence: SSR-embedded JSON: pageTrackingMetadata = {"paginationCurrentNumber":"1","eventId":"565448","eventName":"best-sellers","totalSKUCount":"960"}; page is a paginated DailySalesEventPage listing; 'Best Sellers' appears verbatim as a top-level main-navigation item linking to this exact URL
